name: Dwarven Justice
label: Quest
description: Dwarven Justice: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is an empty, vacuous hole, where my heart used to be, friend. The loss of Dorius is not one that I will soon recover from. I must see his final wish through - the perpetrators of this cold blooded murder must be brought to justice.
Return to the Searing Gorge and fulfill his last request: Free his men.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Forget about me, help the others.
